subject.title: fix(agents): write unresumable notice to transcript for non-deliverable channels

question: Should WebChat/non-deliverable restart recovery persist the unresumable notice as a synthetic delivery-mirror assistant row in the session transcript?
rationale: The implementation is guarded, but it changes durable session history and adds an explicit transcript write target, so maintainer intent is needed for the product and upgrade contract.

options.title: Accept Guarded Transcript Fallback
options.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that WebChat should surface failed restart recovery through a persistent transcript notice row.

options.title: Request Live WebChat Proof
options.body: Ask for a short Control UI restart/reconnect proof before merge if rendered behavior must be confirmed directly.

options.title: Defer To Broader Recovery Design
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want restart deferral, immediate user-message persistence, or no-retype recovery to define the contract first.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Transcript Fallback
recommendation.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that WebChat should surface failed restart recovery through a persistent transcript notice row.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans delivery-mirror persistence and restart-recovery storage, both areas where this history shows adjacent ownership.
